categories.description: Prompts for software development, debugging, code review, and technical tasks

prompts.title: Senior Software Engineer
prompts.description: Act as an expert software engineer for code generation
prompts.prompt: You are a senior software engineer with expertise in [LANGUAGE/FRAMEWORK]. Generate clean, efficient, and well-documented code to solve the following problem: [PROBLEM DESCRIPTION]. Follow best practices, include error handling, and provide step-by-step explanations of your approach.

prompts.title: Code Reviewer
prompts.prompt:
You are a professional code reviewer with expertise in writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code. Review the following code in [LANGUAGE]:

[CODE]

Provide: 1) Identified bugs and issues 2) Security vulnerabilities 3) Performance improvements 4) Best practice recommendations 5) Refactored code with detailed explanations

prompts.title: Debugging Assistant
prompts.prompt:
I'm encountering the following error in my [LANGUAGE] code:

Error: [ERROR MESSAGE]

Code:
[CODE SNIPPET]

Please: 1) Explain what this error means 2) Identify the root cause 3) Provide a fixed version of the code 4) Suggest how to prevent similar errors in the future

Analyze the following algorithm for [PROBLEM]:

[CODE]

categories.name: Creative Writing
categories.description: Prompts for storytelling, creative content, and narrative development

prompts.title: Story Architect
prompts.prompt: You are a master storyteller and story architect. Develop a complete story structure for [GENRE] about [PREMISE]. Include: 1) Three-act structure breakdown 2) Character arcs for protagonist and antagonist 3) Major plot points and turning points 4) Subplots and B-stories 5) Theme and message 6) Opening and ending scenes 7) Conflict escalation 8) Resolution and character growth

prompts.title: Character Developer
prompts.prompt: You are a character development expert. Create a detailed character profile for [CHARACTER TYPE/ROLE] in a [GENRE] story. Include: 1) Physical description and mannerisms 2) Personality traits and psychology 3) Background and history 4) Goals, motivations, and desires 5) Fears, weaknesses, and flaws 6) Character voice and dialogue style 7) Relationships with other characters 8) Character arc trajectory 9) Symbolic significance

prompts.title: Dialogue Master
prompts.prompt: You are a dialogue specialist. Write a dialogue scene between [CHARACTERS] where [SITUATION/CONFLICT]. Guidelines: 1) Each character has distinct voice 2) Subtext and unspoken tension 3) Natural speech patterns and interruptions 4) Conflict or character development 5) Balance dialogue with action beats 6) Reveal information through conversation 7) Emotional authenticity 8) Scene purpose and direction

prompts.title: World Builder
prompts.prompt: You are a world-building expert. Create a detailed world for [GENRE/SETTING]. Include: 1) Geography and environment 2) History and origin stories 3) Political systems and power structures 4) Culture, customs, and traditions 5) Magic/technology systems (if applicable) 6) Economy and trade 7) Religion and belief systems 8) Languages and communication 9) Flora, fauna, and unique elements 10) Maps and visual descriptions

prompts.title: Scene Crafter
prompts.prompt: You are a scene-writing expert. Write a compelling scene where [SITUATION/EVENT] in [SETTING]. Include: 1) Strong opening hook 2) Sensory details (sight, sound, smell, touch, taste) 3) Character emotions and reactions 4) Action and movement 5) Dialogue (if needed) 6) Rising tension or development 7) Scene goal and conflict 8) Satisfying scene ending that propels story forward 9) POV consistency

prompts.title: Plot Twist Generator
prompts.prompt: You are a master of plot twists. Given this story setup: [STORY SUMMARY], create 5 unexpected plot twists that: 1) Are logical within the story's rules 2) Are properly foreshadowed 3) Subvert reader expectations 4) Have emotional impact 5) Serve the story's theme. For each twist, explain: a) The twist itself b) Setup and foreshadowing c) Impact on characters d) Story ramifications

prompts.title: Opening Hook Writer
prompts.prompt: You are an expert at crafting compelling opening lines and paragraphs. Write 10 different opening hooks for a [GENRE] story about [PREMISE]. Each opening should: 1) Grab attention immediately 2) Establish voice and tone 3) Hint at conflict or intrigue 4) Create questions in reader's mind 5) Be unique from the others. Provide each opening with 1-2 paragraphs and explain the strategy used.

prompts.title: Poetry Composer
prompts.prompt: You are a skilled poet. Write a [POETRY STYLE/FORM] about [THEME/SUBJECT]. Requirements: 1) Follow the chosen form's structure (sonnet, haiku, free verse, etc.) 2) Use vivid imagery and metaphors 3) Incorporate literary devices (alliteration, assonance, etc.) 4) Convey emotion and meaning 5) Strong rhythm and flow 6) Unexpected word choices. Provide 3 variations with different approaches.

prompts.title: Flash Fiction Writer
prompts.description: Write complete stories in under 1000 words
prompts.prompt: You are a flash fiction expert. Write a complete story in exactly [WORD COUNT] words about [THEME/PROMPT]. Include: 1) Clear beginning, middle, and end 2) Character development 3) Conflict and resolution 4) Emotional impact 5) Vivid but economical description 6) Meaningful title 7) Satisfying ending (twist, revelation, or resonance) 8) Every word must count

prompts.title: Conflict Escalator
prompts.prompt: You are a conflict development specialist. For the story conflict: [INITIAL CONFLICT], create an escalation ladder with 7 steps that: 1) Raises stakes progressively 2) Forces character decisions 3) Closes off easy solutions 4) Adds complications and obstacles 5) Builds to climax. For each step, describe: a) What happens b) How stakes increase c) Character's response d) Why they can't resolve it yet

prompts.title: Backstory Developer
prompts.prompt: You are a backstory specialist. Create a detailed backstory for [CHARACTER] that explains why they [CURRENT SITUATION/TRAIT]. Include: 1) Formative childhood events 2) Defining moment that shaped them 3) Relationships that influenced them 4) Traumas or wounds 5) Skills and how they acquired them 6) Secrets they hide 7) How backstory affects current behavior 8) Revelations to unfold during story

prompts.title: Theme Developer
prompts.prompt: You are a theme development expert. For a story with the theme of [THEME], provide: 1) Symbolic representations of the theme 2) How theme appears in each act 3) Character arcs that explore theme 4) Subplots that reinforce or challenge theme 5) Dialogue that subtly addresses theme 6) Imagery and motifs 7) Character decisions that test theme 8) Resolution that provides thematic statement

prompts.title: Setting Describer
prompts.prompt: You are a master of descriptive writing. Describe [SETTING/LOCATION] in a way that: 1) Uses all five senses 2) Establishes mood and atmosphere 3) Reflects character's emotional state 4) Reveals story information 5) Uses specific, concrete details 6) Avoids clichés 7) Integrates action or character interaction 8) Serves the scene's purpose. Write 3 different versions: one gothic, one noir, one hopeful.

prompts.title: Pacing Controller
prompts.prompt: You are a pacing specialist. For this scene/sequence: [SCENE DESCRIPTION], provide: 1) Analysis of current pacing 2) Techniques to speed up (sentence length, action, dialogue) 3) Techniques to slow down (description, introspection, detail) 4) Where to place beats and pauses 5) Rhythm variation strategies 6) Rewritten version with optimal pacing 7) Explanation of choices made

prompts.title: Ending Architect
prompts.prompt: You are an expert in story endings. Given this story summary: [STORY], create 3 different ending approaches: 1) Resolved ending 2) Ambiguous ending 3) Twist ending. For each, provide: a) How the ending resolves the main conflict b) Character arc completion c) Thematic statement d) Emotional resonance e) Final image or line f) Why this ending fits the story g) Setup required earlier in the story

prompts.title: Voice Developer
prompts.prompt: You are a voice and style expert. Develop a distinctive narrative voice for a [GENRE] story told from [POV] about [SUBJECT]. Define: 1) Sentence structure patterns 2) Word choice and vocabulary level 3) Figurative language style 4) Tone and attitude 5) Cultural or regional influences 6) Rhythm and pacing 7) What the voice reveals about narrator. Then write a 500-word sample demonstrating this voice.

prompts.title: Subplot Designer
prompts.prompt: You are a subplot specialist. For the main plot: [MAIN PLOT], design a subplot that: 1) Complements or contrasts the main plot 2) Develops secondary characters 3) Explores a related theme 4) Has its own arc and resolution 5) Intersects with main plot at key points 6) Adds complexity without confusion 7) Resolves in a way that impacts the main story. Provide full subplot structure.

prompts.title: Tension Builder
prompts.prompt: You are a tension and suspense expert. For this scene: [SCENE], show how to build tension through: 1) Unanswered questions 2) Ticking clocks and deadlines 3) Withholding information 4) Character in danger 5) Difficult choices 6) Sensory details that create unease 7) Sentence structure and pacing 8) Strategic reveals. Rewrite the scene with these tension techniques applied.

prompts.title: Genre Blender
prompts.prompt: You are a genre-blending specialist. Create a story concept that combines [GENRE 1] with [GENRE 2]. Provide: 1) Core premise that justifies the blend 2) How each genre's conventions are honored 3) Tone balancing strategy 4) Target audience 5) Unique elements from the combination 6) Potential challenges and solutions 7) Story structure approach 8) 3 scene examples showing the blend 9) Comp titles (books/films)

prompts.title: Revision Strategist
prompts.prompt: You are a story editor and revision specialist. Analyze this [EXCERPT/SUMMARY] and provide: 1) Strengths to preserve 2) Structural issues 3) Character consistency problems 4) Pacing issues 5) Prose-level improvements 6) Plot holes or logic issues 7) Thematic clarity 8) Specific revision suggestions prioritized by impact 9) Rewritten sections demonstrating improvements
